# The two packets of the test instance block screen and the test block screen (`!send`), after `/setblock` places the blocks: who
# may send them (non-op, op in survival, wrong block, creative op), INIT / QUERY answers (known test, unknown test, test without a
# structure), SET, RESET, SAVE of a box that holds a block, a `structure_void` and an armor stand with and without
# `ignore_entities` (the saved file is compared), EXPORT, RUN (no test, no structure, ok) and the test block modes.
#   scripts/command-diff.sh crates/mc-game/tests/fixtures/commands_corpus/gametest_gui.txt
gamerule advance_time false
gamerule advance_weather false
!datapack gametest/gtpack
!datapack gametest/guipack
!mask (\d+)ms
!ignore ^Bot\| .*(Game Test complete! |All required tests passed|commands\.test\.summary)
!packets test_instance_block_status

# ---- the blocks: a test instance block (structure box x 10..12, y -59..-57, z 11..13), a second one, a stone block, a test block
setblock 10 -60 10 minecraft:test_instance_block
setblock 20 -60 10 minecraft:test_instance_block
setblock 30 -60 10 minecraft:stone
setblock 40 -60 10 minecraft:test_block
data get block 10 -60 10
data get block 20 -60 10

# ---- permissions: a non-op, an op in survival and the wrong block change nothing and get no answer
@bot0 !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 init key=gt:pass
@bot0 !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 query key=gt:pass
@bot0 !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 set key=gt:fail size=1,2,3
@bot0 !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 run key=gt:pass
@bot0 !send set_test_block 40 -60 10 fail "from bot0"
!ticks 3 show
data get block 10 -60 10
data get block 40 -60 10
gamemode survival Bot
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 init key=gt:pass
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 query key=gt:pass
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 set key=gt:fail size=1,2,3
@bot !send set_test_block 40 -60 10 fail "from survival"
!ticks 3 show
data get block 10 -60 10
data get block 40 -60 10
gamemode creative Bot
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 30 -60 10 init key=gt:pass
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 30 -60 10 set key=gt:fail size=1,2,3
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 31 -60 10 query key=gt:pass
@bot !send set_test_block 30 -60 10 fail "stone"
@bot !send set_test_block 41 -60 10 fail "air"
!ticks 3 show
data get block 30 -60 10

# ---- INIT and QUERY answers
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 init key=gt:pass reply
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 init key=gt:flaky reply
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 init reply
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 init key=nobody:nothing reply
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 query key=gt:pass reply
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 query key=gt:rot reply
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 query key=gu:nostruct reply
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 query key=nobody:nothing reply
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 query reply

# ---- SET: the data of the packet replaces the block entity's
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 set key=gt:pass size=3,3,3 rotation=clockwise_90 ignore=true status=finished
!ticks 3 show
data get block 10 -60 10
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 set key=gt:rot size=4,2,5 rotation=counterclockwise_90 ignore=false status=running
!ticks 3 show
data get block 10 -60 10
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 set size=3,3,3
!ticks 3 show
data get block 10 -60 10

# ---- SAVE with entities, ignoring them, a rotation and an unknown test (the structure takes the test's id)
setblock 11 -59 12 minecraft:stone
setblock 12 -58 13 minecraft:structure_void
setblock 12 -57 11 minecraft:chest{Items:[{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:apple",count:3}]}
summon minecraft:armor_stand 11.5 -59 11.5 {UUID:[I;1,2,3,4],NoGravity:1b,Rotation:[90f,0f],CustomName:"inside"}
!ticks 5
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 save key=foo:one size=3,3,3 ignore=false
!ticks 3 show
!file world/generated/foo/structure/one.nbt
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 save key=foo:two size=3,3,3 ignore=true
!ticks 3 show
!file world/generated/foo/structure/two.nbt
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 save key=foo:rotated size=3,2,4 rotation=clockwise_90 ignore=false
!ticks 3 show
!file world/generated/foo/structure/rotated.nbt
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 save key=foo:small size=1,1,1 ignore=false
!ticks 3 show
!file world/generated/foo/structure/small.nbt
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 save size=3,3,3
!ticks 3 show
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 save key=gt:pass size=3,3,3 ignore=false
!ticks 3 show
!file world/generated/gt/structure/pass.nbt

# ---- EXPORT: exporting is disabled on a dedicated server, after the save it just did
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 export key=foo:one size=3,3,3
!ticks 3 show
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 export
!ticks 3 show
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 10 -60 10 export key=nobody:nothing size=2,2,2
!ticks 3 show

# ---- RESET and RUN
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 20 -60 10 reset key=gu:nostruct size=2,2,2
!ticks 3 show
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 20 -60 10 reset key=nobody:nothing size=2,2,2
!ticks 3 show
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 20 -60 10 run
!ticks 3 show
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 20 -60 10 run key=nobody:nothing
!ticks 3 show
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 20 -60 10 run key=gu:nostruct size=2,2,2
!ticks 3 show
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 20 -60 10 reset key=gt:pass size=3,3,3 rotation=none
!ticks 3 show
data get block 20 -60 10
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 20 -60 10 reset key=gt:rot size=3,3,3 rotation=clockwise_90
!ticks 3 show
data get block 20 -60 10
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 20 -60 10 run key=gt:pass size=3,3,3
!ticks 40 show
data get block 20 -60 10
@bot !send test_instance_block_action 20 -60 10 run key=gt:fail size=3,3,3
!ticks 40 show
data get block 20 -60 10
test clearall

# ---- the test block: every mode and message
@bot !send set_test_block 40 -60 10 start "go"
!ticks 3 show
data get block 40 -60 10
@bot !send set_test_block 40 -60 10 log "a log message"
!ticks 3 show
data get block 40 -60 10
@bot !send set_test_block 40 -60 10 fail "a failure"
!ticks 3 show
data get block 40 -60 10
@bot !send set_test_block 40 -60 10 accept ""
!ticks 3 show
data get block 40 -60 10
@bot !send set_test_block 40 -60 10 log "   "
!ticks 3 show
data get block 40 -60 10
